## Selected findings

## Codex findings: High:** `entire import claude-code` bypasses configured redaction initialization before...

High:** `entire import claude-code` bypasses configured redaction initialization before writing imported transcripts. The command calls `agentimport.Run` directly ([import_cmd.go](/Users/ninawork/entire/devenv/cli/cmd/entire/cli/import_cmd.go:54)), and the importer redacts with `redact.JSONLBytes` ([agentimport.go](/Users/ninawork/entire/devenv/cli/cmd/entire/cli/agentimport/agentimport.go:166)), but it never calls `strategy.EnsureRedactionConfigured()`, which is documented as required before checkpoint writes and loads opt-in PII, `custom_redactions`, and redactor packs ([common.go](/Users/ninawork/entire/devenv/cli/cmd/entire/cli/strategy/common.go:390)). Always-on redaction still runs, but repo/user-configured rules are skipped for imported history. Add the initialization before import writes and cover it with a custom-redaction test.

## Codex findings: Medium:** Imported provenance persists local absolute transcript paths, and also stores...

Medium:** Imported provenance persists local absolute transcript paths, and also stores a SHA-256 over the raw turn slice. The metadata schema explicitly stores `transcript_path` as “absolute path at import time” ([metadata.go](/Users/ninawork/entire/devenv/cli/api/checkpoint/metadata.go:19)), and `writeTurn` writes `sf.Path` into checkpoint metadata ([agentimport.go](/Users/ninawork/entire/devenv/cli/cmd/entire/cli/agentimport/agentimport.go:184)). `ContentHash` is computed from raw, unredacted turn bytes before redaction ([claude.go](/Users/ninawork/entire/devenv/cli/cmd/entire/cli/agentimport/claude.go:119)). Since imported checkpoints live on the normal v1 metadata branch, this can publish local usernames/repo paths and enables confirmation attacks against guessed raw content. Prefer omitting the path, storing only basename/source/session/line bounds, and hashing redacted content if a hash is needed.

## Codex findings: Medium:** The working tree includes untracked raw transcript/debug artifacts and Mach-O...

Medium:** The working tree includes untracked raw transcript/debug artifacts and Mach-O binaries in review scope. For example, `full-example.jsonl` contains raw Claude transcript data with local paths and prompt content ([full-example.jsonl](/Users/ninawork/entire/devenv/cli/full-example.jsonl:2)); `transcript-output.jsonl`, `metadata-example.json`, `compact-debug`, and `migrate-v2-checkpoints` are also untracked. These should be removed, ignored, or sanitized before any PR/commit.

## Codex findings: Low:** Imported checkpoints are read-only and `--generate` is refused ([explain.go](/Us...

Low:** Imported checkpoints are read-only and `--generate` is refused ([explain.go](/Users/ninawork/entire/devenv/cli/cmd/entire/cli/explain.go:685)), but normal explain output still tells users to run `entire explain --generate <id>` when no summary exists ([explain.go](/Users/ninawork/entire/devenv/cli/cmd/entire/cli/explain.go:1669)). Gate that hint on `summary.Imported`.

- `go test ./cmd/entire/cli/agentimport ./cmd/entire/cli/checkpoint ./api/checkpoint`
- `go test ./cmd/entire/cli`
- `git diff --check origin/HEAD...HEAD`

53	// Importer is the per-agent seam: it locates an agent's transcripts for a repo
54	// and splits one into per-turn units. Everything else (idempotency, redaction,
55	// writing) is handled generically by Run.
56	type Importer interface {
57		// Name is the registry key and the provenance source (e.g. "claude-code").

62		// lookback window. overridePath replaces the default transcript dir;
63		// sessionFilter, when non-empty, keeps only matching session IDs.
64		Discover(repoRoot, overridePath string, now time.Time, sessionFilter []string) ([]SessionFile, error)

110	// DeriveCheckpointID produces a stable 12-hex checkpoint ID for an imported
111	// turn. Re-importing the same (sessionID, turnUUID) yields the same ID, which
112	// is how import stays idempotent.
113	func DeriveCheckpointID(sessionID, turnUUID string) id.CheckpointID {
114		sum := sha256.Sum256([]byte(sessionID + "/" + turnUUID))
115		return id.MustCheckpointID(hex.EncodeToString(sum[:6])) // 6 bytes = 12 lowercase hex chars

118	// Run imports the given agent's transcripts (within the lookback window) as
119	// read-only checkpoints on the v1 metadata branch (Kind "imported"). It is
120	// idempotent: turns whose deterministic ID already exists are skipped.
121	func Run(ctx context.Context, repo *git.Repository, imp Importer, opts Options) (Result, error) {
122		var res Result
123		files, err := imp.Discover(opts.RepoRoot, opts.OverridePath, opts.Now, opts.SessionFilter)
124		if err != nil {
125			return res, fmt.Errorf("discover %s sessions: %w", imp.Name(), err)
126		}
127	
128		stores, err := cp.Open(ctx, repo, cp.OpenOptions{})
129		if err != nil {
130			return res, fmt.Errorf("open checkpoint store: %w", err)
131		}
132		existing := make(map[string]bool)
133		if infos, listErr := stores.Persistent.List(ctx); listErr == nil {
134			for _, in := range infos {
135				existing[in.CheckpointID.String()] = true
136			}
137		}
138	
139		for _, sf := range files {
140			res.SessionsScanned++
141			full, readErr := os.ReadFile(sf.Path)
142			if readErr != nil {
143				return res, fmt.Errorf("read %s: %w", sf.Path, readErr)
144			}
145			turns, splitErr := imp.SplitTurns(sf, full)
146			if splitErr != nil {
147				return res, fmt.Errorf("split %s session %s: %w", imp.Name(), sf.SessionID, splitErr)
148			}
149			// Redact the session transcript once and reuse it for every turn's
150			// checkpoint (each turn stores the full session transcript with its own
151			// CheckpointTranscriptStart). Redacting per turn would be O(turns).
152			// Computed lazily so a fully-skipped or dry-run file pays nothing.
153			var red redact.RedactedBytes
154			redacted := false
155			for _, turn := range turns {
156				cid := DeriveCheckpointID(sf.SessionID, turn.UUID)
157				if existing[cid.String()] {
158					res.TurnsSkipped++
159					continue
160				}
161				if opts.DryRun {
162					res.TurnsImported++ // counts what would import
163					continue
164				}
165				if !redacted {
166					r, rerr := redact.JSONLBytes(full)
167					if rerr != nil {
168						return res, fmt.Errorf("redact %s transcript: %w", sf.SessionID, rerr)
169					}
170					red, redacted = r, true
171				}
172				if err := writeTurn(ctx, stores, imp, cid, sf, red, turn); err != nil {
173					return res, err
174				}
175				existing[cid.String()] = true
176				res.TurnsImported++
177			}
178		}
179		return res, nil
180	}

184			Source: imp.Name(), TranscriptPath: sf.Path, SessionID: sf.SessionID,
185			TurnUUID: turn.UUID, ParentUUID: turn.ParentUUID,
186			LineStart: turn.LineStart, LineEnd: turn.LineEnd,
187			ContentHash: turn.ContentHash, ImportVersion: importVersion,
188		}
189		if err := stores.Persistent.Write(ctx, cp.Session(cp.WriteOptions{
190			CheckpointID:              cid,
191			SessionID:                 sf.SessionID,
192			CreatedAt:                 turn.CreatedAt,
193			Strategy:                  "import",
194			Kind:                      string(session.KindImported),
195			Agent:                     imp.AgentType(),
196			Model:                     turn.Model,
197			Transcript:                red,
198			Prompts:                   []string{turn.Prompt},
199			CheckpointsCount:          1,
200			CheckpointTranscriptStart: turn.LineStart,
201			TokenUsage:                turn.Tokens,
202			Provenance:                prov,
203		})); err != nil {
204			return fmt.Errorf("write imported checkpoint %s: %w", cid, err)
205		}
206		return nil
207	}

**Finding 1 (High) — redaction config bypass** · `cmd/entire/cli/import_cmd.go`
Added `strategy.EnsureRedactionConfigured()` before `agentimport.Run`, so imported transcripts get repo/user-configured opt-in PII, `custom_redactions`, and redactor packs — not just always-on secret scanning. **Finding 2 (Medium) — provenance leaks** · `api/checkpoint/metadata.go`, `cmd/entire/cli/agentimport/{agentimport,claude}.go`

- Moved `ContentHash` computation out of `claude.go` (where it hashed raw bytes) into `Run`, where it hashes the **redacted** turn slice via a new `contentHash` helper — closing the confirmation-attack vector against guessed raw content. Dropped the now-unused `Turn.ContentHash` field and `crypto/sha256`/`encoding/hex` imports from `claude.go`.

**Finding 4 (Low) — misleading explain hint** · `cmd/entire/cli/explain.go`
Gated the `--generate` hint on `summary.Imported`; imported checkpoints now show "Imported history is read-only, so summaries cannot be generated." instead of pointing at a command that errors out.
